### the-queue.md never bounds its growth claim, and LESSONS.md already carries the bound

pattern/the-queue.md ends its 'loop that closes' section with: Acting on one idea reliably generates several more, which is why the queue grows as you work it — that is the mechanism functioning, not a backlog. True while you are opening new ground, and the chapter never bounds it.
